desc: a lent partner really joining: three players at the prologue's end, player 3 walks a lent Koops; Koops joins (still player 3's, now a companion Mario has: no new one); Mario's partner is swapped to Koops, so player 3 gets Goombella (one Mario has, not lent). Shots: lent (Koops), joined (Koops still player 3's), swapped (Koops the partner, Goombella with '3P')
